about: Yes/No questions for rocket2.html. 'when' is the mission moment (start, fuel, hatch, ready, orbit, chute). 'levels' lists the modes that ask it. type 'choice': both answers are fine; yesAction/noAction tell the game what to do (continue, later, next, learn_parts, go_home). type 'check': the game knows the true answer; 'right' is spoken for the correct answer, 'wrong' for the other one, then it asks again.

questions.text: Do you want to fly the rocket today?
questions.no: No. OK. Let's look at the rocket first. Tap a picture to learn a part.
questions.again: Do you want to fly the rocket now?

right.no: No! The tank is not full yet.

questions.wrong: Look again. Look at the fuel gauge.

right.no: No! The hatch is still open.

questions.wrong: Look again. Look at the hatch light.

questions.again: Are you ready to launch now?

questions.text: Do you want to go home now?
questions.no: No. OK. Let's fly around the Earth a little more.
questions.again: Do you want to go home now?

questions.text: Do you want to open the parachutes?
questions.no: No? We need the parachutes to land slowly!
questions.again: Do you want to open the parachutes?
